metadata.title: Blaschke--Santaló inequalities with respect to costs
metadata.abstract: We study functional Blaschke--Santaló inequalities in which the inner product is replaced by a cost. An inequality on each orthant, combined with Steiner symmetrization, gives a sufficient condition for a cost inequality to hold for even convex functions. We apply this principle to a multiplicative cost defined on all orthants. Its second variation gives a weighted improvement of the Brascamp--Lieb inequality in the directions for which differentiation is justified. We also prove an $L^p$ version of the Fradelizi--Meyer theorem from a weighted volume-product inequality and derive the corresponding radial cost and Brascamp--Lieb inequalities. Explicit examples include anisotropic power and Cauchy densities, with dilation equality cases and a sharp obstruction below the coordinate exponent two. For the spherical logarithmic cost we compute an exact entropy--logdet deficit decomposition and the second-order deficit transverse to ellipsoids. We also explain the transport-entropy formulation and distinguish the restricted spectral question from the scalar $(B)$ property.

analysis.workSummary: 以一般 cost 替代内积研究泛函 Blaschke–Santaló 不等式，结合正交象限上的估计和 Steiner 对称化给出偶凸函数的充分条件，并推出加权 Brascamp–Lieb 改进、Lp 版本及球面对数 cost 的 deficit 分解。
analysis.breakthrough: 把多种体积乘积和谱不等式纳入 cost 框架，并记录等号与指数阈值障碍。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。二阶变分只在有正当微分依据的方向成立；受限谱问题与标量 (B) 性质须分别理解。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 按与几何研究的关联、结论范围和可迁移方法安排阅读；二阶变分只在有正当微分依据的方向成立；受限谱问题与标量 (B) 性质须分别理解。
